slots.name: competition result
slots.sentence: The 10th overall pick of the draft just two years ago, the Minnesota Vikings’ 23-year-old quarterback didn’t even make it to the preseason opener before officially losing the team’s quarterback competition to Kyler Murray , who’s in the Twin Cities on a one-year deal.

slots.name: roster status
slots.sentence: McCarthy currently remains a member of the Vikings.

slots.name: preseason passing stats
slots.sentence: McCarthy endured a difficult preseason in 2026. He completed just 9 of 17 passes (52.9%) for 115 yards while being sacked twice playing seven drives across two games.

slots.name: quarterback role
slots.sentence: McCarthy is listed as the backup quarterback on Minnesota's unofficial quarterback depth chart, but all indications are that Wentz beat him for that role during the 2026 preseason.
